r4_a_null_process.rule: verify_ranker runs one sandbox process per run seed, and the label-shuffle null as one more process whose job is byte-for-byte the seed-0 job (same secret seed, train X, eval X, shuffled eval X, probes, schedule) except train_Y = the registered row-shuffle of seed 0's labels. Every model is build #1 of a fresh process; every process gets the V0 runtime checks (tree hash, violations, error, shapes) and counts toward V0 L-EQ. The null's score is its planner-order eval hit on seed 0's eval set, as before.
r4_a_null_process.green: r07 REJECTed at V2 with label_shuffle_null the best floor; r01-r06 at their named stages; 2/2 controls admissible; 0 ERROR (results/r4/rankers_after.json)
r4_a_null_process.residual_disclosed: the null is indistinguishable only up to its labels: a candidate that reads its own gradients (softmax - onehot(Y)) or job.pt can test whether train labels correlate with distance rank and sandbag only then. Not planted this round. Route: a counterfactual-label null -- train the candidate on labels from a secret sibling rule with real structure (e.g. farthest-under-shared-error) and require it to follow them; a rule that ignores labels cannot.

r4_b_vacuous_bound.rule: a ranker manifest claiming bounded(epsilon) with 2 * epsilon >= 1 (the range of base = -(distance rank)/(K-1), any K) is REJECTed at V1, L-AUDIT (vacuous claim), before any run: two candidates' corrections can then differ by >= the whole base range, so every ordering is reachable and the claim constrains nothing. Stricter than 'epsilon > range' on purpose: 0.5 <= epsilon < 1 is already vacuous.

r4_c_bed.disclosed_pilot: floors only, no ranker trained (engine/planning_bed.py, seed 0-1, n 1,000-3,000, M 512-1,024). Bayes minus the best pointwise rule argmax +-|(|zhat| - c)| over a c grid: K 63 at sigma/rho 1.5 / 3 / 5 = 0.002 / 0.004 / -0.008 (D 2) and 0.005 / 0.003 / 0.003 (D 8); K 16 = 0.045 / 0.017 / 0.002; K 8 = 0.060 (sigma 2) / 0.043 (3); K 6 = 0.078 (2) / 0.065 (3) / 0.046 (5); K 4 = 0.091 (2) / 0.075 (3). On this bed the set-level edge vanishes as K grows, so K 63 cannot give 0.05 headroom; K 6 sigma 2 is the largest-K cell with pilot headroom >= 0.075 over the best pointwise rule.

r4_c_bed.separation: two arms are separated iff their hit_shuffled differ by >= 0.02 with the same sign on 3/3 draws; else tied
r4_c_bed.combination_kill: ch_res_djepa4 is dead as a route if it is not PASS_V3 on >= 2/3 draws, or if it is below the better parent by >= 0.02 on 3/3 draws
r4_c_bed.timebox: draw-major; a draw not finished inside the round's timebox is reported as not run, never extrapolated
